title: Axial force and opening of a pretension cut
source: Closed-form axial-bar series compliance and force equilibrium: q = F Σ L/(EA), with the values and substitution shown in README.md.

quantities.reason: Two unit-area axial segments of lengths 1 m and E = 1e6 Pa carry F = 1000 N: q = F(L1/(EA) + L2/(EA)) = 0.002 m; the continuous two-hex mesh has this exact linear field.
Static equilibrium of the two segments gives the same axial force F = 1000 N on both sides of the cut.
The prescribed generalized cut load is F = 1000 N by construction.
